name: atlas-video
description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus two subagents that keep searches and pages out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant adds video made on this machine: written with HyperFrames, Remotion or Manim, or recorded from the screen with a camera that follows the cursor.
